newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers on downtrend amid weak demand.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers on downtrend amid weak demand.

text.p: Singapore bunkers on Tuesday were on a downward trend amid weak sentiment, traders said.
"Demand in Japan is very healthy as they return from holiday," a trader said. "But in Singapore and Korea, it is quiet. Shipowners are only testing levels and are not serious."

Indications for 180-cst bunker fuel were at $121-$123, down from Monday's $121-$124. Offers of 380-cst were firm at $117-$119 but trade was reported at $117. Small lots of MDO and gas oil were traded at $204 and $225, but offers were widely quoted at $200-210 and $219-$225 respectively.
